As a performance marketing agency in Kochi, Teknoppy combines technical SEO, paid Google and Meta media, conversion-focused creative, and transparent analytics, so every rupee you spend is tracked to a result. Our clients include startups, hospitals, real estate firms, restaurants, manufacturers, and established enterprises who need leads, not just likes.

process.intro: Our process follows six clearly defined stages, so every campaign is built on strategy, measured accurately, and optimised toward a business outcome:

steps.title: Audit & Goal Mapping (Week 1)
steps.desc: We audit your website, search visibility, ads, and competitors, then define the real goal — leads, calls, or sales — and the baseline metrics.

steps.title: Tracking & Measurement Setup (Week 2)
steps.desc: GA4, Google Search Console, conversion events, and call tracking are configured first, so results are attributable from day one.

steps.title: Strategy & Channel Plan (Week 3)
steps.desc: We choose the channels that fit your market and budget — SEO, Google Ads, Meta ads, or a blend — with a clear plan, timeline, and forecast.

steps.title: Campaign Launch & Creative (Week 4)
steps.desc: We produce the assets — copy, creative, landing pages, ad sets, and optimised content — and launch in controlled phases to validate before scaling.

steps.title: Optimisation & A/B Testing (Ongoing)
steps.desc: Continuous refinement of keywords, bids, audiences, and creative based on live data — cutting waste and doubling down on what produces leads.

steps.title: Monthly Reporting & Scaling
steps.desc: Transparent monthly reports on leads, cost-per-result, and ROI, plus a review call to decide where to scale budgets next.

faqs.intro: Get quick answers to standard questions about digital marketing pricing, timelines, ad budgets, and how we measure results:

items.q: How much does digital marketing cost in Kochi?
items.a: Most Kochi businesses invest between Rs. 10,000 and Rs. 75,000 per month depending on channels and competition, while full-funnel programmes range higher. Google and Meta ads require a separate ad spend budget paid directly to the platforms. We share a written quote before any work begins.

items.q: How long does digital marketing take to show results?
items.a: Paid ads like Google Ads and Meta Ads can generate leads within days of campaign launch. SEO and content typically show meaningful organic traction in 3 to 6 months and compound from there.

items.q: Which is the best digital marketing company in Kochi?
items.a: The best agency is the one that fits your goal and can prove results. Check five things: case studies with numbers, a named person who runs your account, transparent pricing, access to your own ad and analytics accounts, and monthly reports on leads and cost per lead. Teknoppy, based in Vyttila since 2018, works this way for clients across Kochi.

items.q: Is there a minimum contract period?
items.a: Our plans run month to month after an initial 3-month onboarding period. SEO and content need time to demonstrate compounding organic gains, while paid ad campaigns can be scaled or adjusted monthly.

items.q: How do you report campaign results?
items.a: You receive a transparent monthly report and strategy review covering leads generated, cost per lead, traffic, keyword rankings, and ad spend ROI, backed by live Google Analytics 4 and Looker Studio dashboards.

items.q: How much should I spend on Google or Meta ads?
items.a: Most local Kochi businesses start with Rs. 15,000 to Rs. 40,000 per month in ad spend, scaling budgets once cost-per-lead is validated. Ad spend is paid directly to Google or Meta and is separate from our management fee.

items.q: Who owns our ad accounts and marketing data?
items.a: You do. All ad accounts, Google Analytics 4 properties, and Google Search Console accounts are created under your business credentials. Teknoppy manages them with delegated partner access.

items.q: Do you optimise for AI answer engines like ChatGPT and Perplexity?
items.a: Yes. Alongside traditional SEO we structure content and schema for answer engines and generative search (AEO and GEO) — clear question-led sections and verifiable detail AI assistants can cite.

items.q: Can I meet your team in Kochi?
items.a: Yes. Our office is in Vyttila, Ernakulam, and most Kochi clients meet us in person for kick-off and quarterly reviews. Clients elsewhere in Kerala work with us online — see our Kerala digital marketing services.
